# Rate Cloud

> Multilingual public reference (English, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French) for Rate Cloud, a subscription-based API service for GLM, DeepSeek, and Qwen. Source snapshot: November 3, 2026.

## Documentation website

- [Rate Cloud documentation](https://shaitor52.github.io/RateCloud/): HTML pages and language navigation. The English homepage source is [README.md](README.md).
- [Documentation index](https://shaitor52.github.io/RateCloud/llms.txt): direct links to every page.

## Official website

- [Rate Cloud](https://rate-cloud.com/): Product, models, subscriptions, and published performance.
- [How it works](https://rate-cloud.com/how-it-works): Public architecture, quantization, routing, privacy, and availability.
- [API documentation](https://rate-cloud.com/docs): Current endpoints, model IDs, and setup guidance.
- [White Label](https://rate-cloud.com/white-label): Partner service offering.

Three- and seven-day values are converted from the public subscription dialog using the dated public display-currency API rate; 30-day USD values come from that API. Confirm current displayed prices.
- [Performance and pricing datasets](data/README.md)

## Interpretation

The Markdown overview summarizes the public offers, trial, subscription durations, and concurrency. The generated documentation homepage also renders the localized offer cards from the product data.

Unlimited tokens means no cumulative token quota during an active subscription. Context, deadlines, concurrency, and availability remain finite. Historical performance is not guaranteed. Architectural descriptions are not an independent production audit. Refer to the live website and applicable terms for current conditions.

## Infrastructure and offers

- [Our infrastructure](articles/10-infrastructure.md): compute leasing, model deployment, hardware families and inference operations.
- [Referral program](articles/11-referral-program.md): invitation benefits and eligible-payment bonuses, distinct from White Label.
- [Register and try Rate Cloud](https://rate-cloud.com/register): standard trial subject to verification and eligibility.
